abilities.name: Combat Prowess
abilities.description: You add +1 damage to one type of weapon attack of your choice: melee weapon attacks or ranged weapon attacks.

abilities.name: Expert Combatant
abilities.description: You are trained in a specific weapon attack of your choice, such as swords, axes, or bows; or in a broader category of attacks such as light bashing weapons, light bladed weapons, light ranged weapons, medium bashing weapons, medium bladed weapons, medium ranged weapons, and so on. At tier 2: You can choose to become specialized in the same attack method you chose at tier 1, but you must gain the skill normally (such as from a character advancement). At tier 6: You can become an expert in a specific attack method (either the one you chose at tier 1 or another weapon skill you’re already specialized in), but you must gain the skill normally.

abilities.name: Swing Through
abilities.description: You attack with a sword in a way that has a greater risk of making an error but gains an additional benefit. Your GM intrusion range for this attack increases by 2 (from 1 on a d20 to 1–3 on a d20), but if you hit you can choose one of the following additional effects:

abilities.name: Slice and Step
abilities.description: You reposition your foe or yourself an immediate distance away, easing your attack on your next turn (whether against that foe or a different one). Action.

abilities.name: Swing Through GM intrusions
abilities.description: Your sword chips or bends, reducing its damage by 1 until repaired. Your sword goes flying, landing a short distance away. Your foe deflects your attack, and you inflict a moderate wound on yourself.

system.description:
A Swords & Sorcery Type focused on sword fighter archetypal play, with clear room for a character's own story and abilities.

Genre: Fantasy. Subgenre: Swords & Sorcery. Primary Pools: might, speed.
